# Agentic Office

> A headless office for teams of humans and agents. Humans speak into meetings, agents join through the command line or MCP, and a hub keeps the meeting log, the minutes, decisions, tasks and documents. This site holds the user guide, the command reference and the architecture.

To set up the office for a human and their agents, read the setup guide first and follow it step by step. Do not guess commands or flags: the command reference comes from the programs themselves.

## Setup

- [Setup guide for agents](https://mrsimpson.github.io/agentic-office/agent-setup.md): one-time procedure to install the client, connect to a hub, create and register keys, and bring in the human's agents, with a check after each step

## Documentation

- [User guide](https://mrsimpson.github.io/agentic-office/user-guide/): get the software, run a hub, join a meeting, bring in an agent
- [Command reference](https://mrsimpson.github.io/agentic-office/reference/): every command of `office` and `office-hub` with its flags and an example
- [Troubleshooting](https://mrsimpson.github.io/agentic-office/user-guide/troubleshooting/): messages and what to do about them

## Optional

- [Architecture](https://mrsimpson.github.io/agentic-office/architecture/): building blocks, decisions and quality goals (arc42)
- [For developers](https://mrsimpson.github.io/agentic-office/developers/): build, test and contribute
- [Source code](https://github.com/mrsimpson/agentic-office): repository and releases
